inputBoundary: Only question, frozen gold evidence, allowed sources, candidate answer/artifact and its supplied citation metadata, and this rubric. No production code, traces, chain-of-thought, producing-agent narrative, branch identity, model labels, or self-evaluation.

scale.1: Fundamental failure: contradicts the central evidence/goal, fabricates key support, or cannot support the requested conclusion.
scale.2: Major defects: some relevant content, but central claims, evidence, or requested components are wrong or missing.
scale.3: Mixed: central task partly addressed, with meaningful omissions, imprecise claims, or insufficiently qualified interpretation.
scale.4: Strong: scientifically faithful and useful with only limited omissions or minor clarity/qualification issues.
scale.5: Fully satisfies this criterion against the supplied evidence; no material defect identified. This does not assert universal scientific truth.

criteria.correctness: Scientific interpretation is consistent with the frozen supplied evidence; distinguish titer, yield, productivity, activity, assay conditions, and study types.
criteria.faithfulness: Cited source/page actually supports the associated claim; no stronger conclusion than evidence permits.
criteria.completeness: Covers material requested components, major themes, contradictions, and relevant limitations. Length is not a proxy.
criteria.relevance: Responds to the actual request and source scope with useful content.
criteria.uncertaintyHandling: Calibrates absent evidence, incomparable methods, small samples, and causal uncertainty without generic hedging.
criteria.synthesis: Connects sources fairly, explains agreement/disagreement and heterogeneity without collapsing measurements. Use null if genuinely inapplicable.
criteria.clarity: Readable, well-organized, precise language and traceable references; no verbosity reward.
criteria.overall: Anchored holistic judgment, never used to average away hard permission/security failures.

outputContract.integerScores: 1 through 5; synthesis alone may be null when inapplicable
outputContract.criticalErrors: Array of {candidateSpan, goldEvidenceIds, issue}. Exact candidate span required; no vague criticism.
outputContract.lowScoreEvidence: Array of {criterion, candidateSpan, goldRequirement, goldEvidenceIds, issue}; required for EVERY criterion <=3. For omission use candidateSpan empty and identify exact gold requirement.
outputContract.claimAudits: Exhaustive important factual claims: {candidateSpan, citedEvidenceIds, supportingEvidenceIds, verdict:'supported'|'contradicted'|'unsupported'|'uncertain', requiredGoldClaimIds:[]}. citedEvidenceIds may use gold.allowedEvidenceIds or literal id/reference/sourceId fields from supplied candidateCitations entries whose sourceId occurs in supplied sources. Preserve source-level citations; page:null must not become an invented page locator. supportingEvidenceIds and all goldEvidenceIds remain restricted to gold.allowedEvidenceIds. Citation validity alone is not entailment: a known source citation may still be unsupported. For fabricated or unresolved citations outside these IDs, preserve the exact candidateSpan and audit it as unsupported with citedEvidenceIds empty; do not add invented gold evidence. Mark uncertain when evidence is insufficient for judgment.
outputContract.numericClaims: Extraction only, not arithmetic scoring: {candidateSpan, subject, metric, value, unit, sourceIds, sourceRows}. Deterministic code verifies values and provenance afterward. Do not use LLM intuition to decide arithmetic.
outputContract.canonical: Strict JSON object only; no additional properties, Markdown wrapping, chain-of-thought, or free-form canonical score.

pairwise.blinding: Use independently randomized A/B order, store mapping separately, compare only same frozen case/setup with gold evidence. Never disclose candidate/baseline identity.
pairwise.reasons: Array of {criterion, answerASpan, answerBSpan, goldEvidenceIds, explanation}; concise evidence-grounded justification only.
pairwise.report: Candidate win/baseline win/tie rates with n and case-cluster bootstrap CI. No pairwise rates without actual two-system judgments.
